items.review_text: My garage door was not shutting properly it was very loud and door was not balanced.  I called TML and they came out the next day. The technician who showed up was very knowledgeable and he was quick at assessing the problem once he let me know one of my springs was broken and my rollers were stuck I gave him the go ahead to fix it. My garage shuts better than it ever has and it's super quiet now. I highly recommend them and I also would recommend asking for Bar to come out and fix your problem he was great. I will definitely use them again and I will be requesting Bar to do the work.
Excellent service from start to finish! Fast response, fair pricing, and high-quality work. The team was professional and knowledgeable. Highly recommend!

As a single disabled woman who is also a caregiver to an elderly parent I need my garage door to open and especially close with not a lot of effort.  Today when my garage door went caput and stopped working I couldn’t open nor close it and it needs to be closed.  I don’t need the stray cats or creatures coming in.  Also it’s safety and security for my household. Roy from TML garage door services came as swiftly as possible gave me a fair price to replace and repair whatever part broke.  He did it as quickly as 30 minutes and now I’m able to close my home safely.  I truly am appreciative of the quick and fast service provided to me.  Roy was professional and quick to fix my garage door problem.
